part1_forecasts.statement: The U.S. will collect over $300 million in tariff revenue from advanced AI chip imports by the end of 2027, based on the 25% tariff imposed in January 2026.

resolution_criteria.metric: Total tariff revenue from advanced AI chips
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: USD; cumulative collected revenue in U.S. dollars; all levied tariffs on covered chips

part1_forecasts.statement: Foreign direct investment into U.S. AI infrastructure, incentivized by export controls like those in E05, will exceed $10 billion in 2028.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Economic Analysis
resolution_criteria.metric: Foreign direct investment in U.S. AI infrastructure
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: USD; annual FDI inflow specifically categorized under AI infrastructure; includes announced and in-force investments

part1_forecasts.statement: The U.S. AI chip industry's domestic production capacity will increase by at least 15% by 2029 due to government policies aimed at fostering domestic production.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. Department of Commerce, Semiconductor Industry Association
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: percentage increase; year-over-year growth in wafer starts or output; measured from 2026 baseline

part1_forecasts.statement: OpenAI's API credits offered as part of its industrial policy framework will be fully utilized by at least 50 research institutions globally by the end of 2027.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of research institutions utilizing API credits
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: count; institutions fully utilizing credits for research purposes; confirmed by OpenAI usage reports

part1_forecasts.statement: Lobbying expenditures by companies like AMD and KLA Corp. focused on AI trade and export controls will cumulatively exceed $10 million by the end of 2027.

resolution_criteria.metric: Cumulative lobbying expenditures on AI trade and export controls
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: USD; sum of disclosed lobbying expenditures by specified companies; reported quarterly

part1_forecasts.statement: U.S. productivity growth will average at least 1.8% annually between 2027 and 2030, reflecting a potential positive impact from targeted AI industrial policy.

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: annual growth rate; average over the specified period; confirmed by BLS publications

part1_forecasts.statement: The U.S. Department of Commerce will adjust its license review policy for high-end chip exports at least three more times by the end of 2029 to further refine strategic selectivity.

resolution_criteria.source: U.S. Department of Commerce, Bureau of Industry and Security (BIS)
resolution_criteria.metric: Number of policy adjustments to high-end chip export license review
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: count; formal rule changes or policy statements by BIS; excluding minor clarifications

part1_forecasts.statement: At least five countries will publicly commit to matching investments in American AI infrastructure by the end of 2028, mirroring the tiered export control regulations.

resolution_criteria.source: Department of State, Bilateral Agreements Database
resolution_criteria.metric: Number of countries making matching investment commitments for AI infrastructure
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: count; public bilateral or multilateral agreements specifying matching investment; formal commitments

part1_forecasts.statement: The global venture investment in AI will grow by at least 50% from its 2026 level by the end of 2031, driven by continued state-led industrial policy and AI development.

resolution_criteria.counting_convention: USD; cumulative annual investment; measured in current U.S. dollars

part1_forecasts.statement: The U.S. will secure at least two new bilateral AI supply chain security agreements with key allies by the end of 2028, reinforcing strategic competition in the AI age.

resolution_criteria.metric: Number of bilateral AI supply chain security agreements
resolution_criteria.counting_convention: count; formally signed international agreements; confirmed by State Department treaty records
